say:2:1710830001:1.text: That maneuver just now... I gave no command, but you understood.
say:2:1710830001:1.source_cn: 刚才一瞬间的侧身位配合，我并没有下达指令，但你却理解了。

say:3:1710830002:1.text: Because I knew you'd block the strike and create an opening for me.
say:3:1710830002:1.source_cn: 因为我知道，您一定能挡下那一击，并为我制造出反击的空隙。

say:4:1710830003:1.text: I didn't need to hesitate, I only needed to take the shot.
say:4:1710830003:1.source_cn: 我不需要犹豫，只需要把箭射出去。

say:5:1710830004:0.text: ... All this time, I focused on keeping the danger away from you, keeping you safely behind me.
say:5:1710830004:0.source_cn: ……一直以来，我只想着如何把盾立得更稳，把你严严实实地...

say:6:1710830005:1.text: I forgot that even the strongest defense requires offense.
say:6:1710830005:1.source_cn: 却忘了，最好的防守也需要进攻来配合。

say:7:1710830006:1.text: I've grown, Commander. Just as you're the shield of the empire, I wish to be the arrow this empire fires.
say:7:1710830006:1.source_cn: 我已经长大了，司令。 就像您是耀光的盾，我也想成为能为...

say:8:1710830007:1.text: A shield shouldn't exist only to block. It should become the archer's surest cover.
say:8:1710830007:1.source_cn: 盾牌不应该只用来阻挡攻击，而应该成为弓手最坚实的掩体。

say:9:1710830008:1.text: You protected me. Now... let me stand beside you.
say:9:1710830008:1.source_cn: 以前是您守护我，现在……请让我也与您并肩而战。

say:10:1710830009:1.text: ... I can trust you, Captain Gwyneth.
say:10:1710830009:1.source_cn: ……我想，我可以把后背交给你了，格温妮丝队长。

narration:11:1710830010:1.text: No longer father and daughter, but commander and captain.

narration:12:1710830011:1.text: The distance born of overprotection melts away in the fading light of that arrow...

narration:13:1710830012:1.text: And father and daughter reconcile amid the embers of war.
